newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: One killed in NZ bank hostage drama - police.
newsitem.headline: One killed in NZ bank hostage drama - police.

text.p: One person was killed on Wednesday in an armed holdup at a bank in Naenae, near Lower Hutt, a police spokesman said.
"All we can say is a person has been found dead in the bank," Senior Sergeant Ted Jordan told Radio New Zealand.
The radio reported that the dead person was a woman, but Jordan declined to confirm that.
"There is a man in custody and I understand he is helping with inquiries at the moment," he said. No one else had been hurt or injured.

The hostage drama took place at the Naenae branch of Trust Bank and lasted about an hour. The number of people involved was unclear, although Jordan said it had initially appeared there were five hostages.
The police armed offenders squad was called in, but Jordan said it arrived after the victim had been shot dead.
It was not clear if the dead person was a bank employee or a customer. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
